Turn the bounded \(n\le4\) kill test into a specified exhaustive search contract, including how failed denominator-lock rank systems certify a genuine counterexample to the extraction handle.

Separate the completeness theorem from the output-sensitive claim until the extractor supplies a concrete streaming representation, then prove the \(O(3^n\operatorname{poly}(n)+L_\Gamma)\) accounting for every extraction branch.
